name: star-writing-skills
description: A general research-paper toolkit with stable writing contracts, optional project-local learning records, and evidence-gated workflow evolution.

interface.shortDescription: Build defensible research papers from idea to submission.
interface.longDescription: A modular, cross-disciplinary research-paper system for paper onboarding, interactive proposition and terminology control, framing, literature positioning, technical method audits, evidence design, drafting, prose polishing, purpose-specific review, live submission checks, optional project-local learning records, and evidence-gated promotion into reusable workflow rules.
defaultPrompt: Orient to this paper and recommend the next defensible writing step.
Draft or revise a manuscript section from verified claims and evidence.
Audit this manuscript's method, claims, evidence, and consistency.
